localised_description: The wild Griffons of Ulthuan are creatures of noble bearing and keen intelligence, with whom Elves form bonds that only death can shatter.
An extremely light yet resilient material, Ithilmar gives the same protection as heavy steel, but without slowing down its wearer.
Ulthuan's Great Eagles are the firm allies of the Elves, fighting their causes since the coming of Chaos.
Those who ride atop the mighty Moon Drakes are steeled in the knowledge of their mount’s enlightened, Daemon-slaying strength.
The eldest, most powerful Dragons can destroy entire units with a molten blast of their white-hot breath.
